summary: Named only on the tnlandforms NC tower list (NCT157) and a county forestry page photo captioned Fire Tower; no history, status or access source found.

evidence.supports: A list of North Carolina lookout towers includes a tower called Scotland County, with the county given as Scotland, and gives its coordinates.
The North Carolina Forest Service Scotland County office is on US 15-501, about ten miles north of Laurinburg.
evidence.quote: The Scotland County office is located on US 15-501, approximately 10 miles north of the city of Laurinburg.

evidence.supports: The county's page for the Forest Service office shows a photograph captioned Fire Tower.
The office page has a picture of the office entrance, captioned North Carolina Forest Service Office Entrance.
evidence.quote: North Carolina Forest Service Office Entrance

evidence.supports: The office page has a picture of a brush truck, captioned Forest Service Brush Truck.

sources.title: N.C. Forest Service Contacts - Scotland County

notes_for_editor: Only a list entry and an office-page photo caption support this record. The caption does not say where the tower stands, and the story does not link the tower to the office. The list's nr EB3901 reference looks like a survey mark, so it is not recorded as a register. Status and access stay unknown; a state or county history of Scotland County towers would be the next source to look for.
